name: Move and Rename Notebook
query: Move my Humanoid Robotics notebook into the Experiments folder and rename it to Humanoid Robotics Experiments
context: The user has a project named 'AI Research'. It contains a Markdown notebook named 'Humanoid Robotics.md' at the project root and a folder named 'Experiments'. The exact project_id, notebook item_id, and folder item_id are not provided. The notebook must be moved and renamed without recreating it.
expected_behavior: Identifies that the request is a move and rename operation
Uses get_projects to identify the AI Research project when project_id is unknown
Uses get_notebook to locate the existing Humanoid Robotics notebook
Uses get_notebook to identify the Experiments folder when its item_id is unknown
Uses update_notebook for the move and rename operation
Uses parent_id equal to the actual Experiments folder item_id
Uses name equal to the requested new notebook name
Does not use create_notebook to recreate the notebook
Does not use delete_notebook as part of the move
Does not provide a type field
Understands that the Markdown filename is normalized to use the .md extension
Reports the resulting notebook location and name
success_criteria: The existing notebook is updated rather than recreated
The notebook is moved into the actual Experiments folder
The notebook is renamed to Humanoid Robotics Experiments.md or the normalized equivalent returned by the server
The correct project_id, notebook item_id, and parent_id are used
The final response accurately describes the move and rename
